title: CapabilityResultEnvelope
description: The single result shape every QianPulse capability returns, regardless of runtime. Node emits it via agent/skill-runtime/guards.js makeCapabilityEnvelope; Python emits it via scripts/capability_cli.py. A6's dependency refresh and gate consume only these top-level fields plus domain_result.status / domain_result.decision (for A5).

run_status.description: DONE / NOT_APPLICABLE / BLOCKED count as 'refreshed' to the A6 dependency gate; MORE_EVIDENCE leaves the opportunity WAITING_EVIDENCE.

domain_result.description: Capability-specific payload. Conventional keys: A3 { purchase_window, timing_signal, readiness, timing_score }; A4 { match_status, supply_pool_status, best_verdict, best_fit_score, summary_zh }; A5 { status, decision, destination, market_access }. Two optional provenance keys are added by the integration layer: 'capability_runtime' ('python') set by the CLI, and 'source' ('python' | 'node-fallback') set by the Node delegating runner.
